23419-the-return-of-the-soul-1896.title: The Return Of The Soul 1896
23419-the-return-of-the-soul-1896.creator: Robert S. Hichens
23419-the-return-of-the-soul-1896.description: A book by Robert S. Hichens. What he says can't be true. When I have filled these pages, and read what I have written dispassionately, as one of the outside public might read, I shall have done, once for all, with the ridiculous fancies that are beginning to make my life a burden. To put my thoughts in order will make a music.

67347-the-loom-of-the-desert.title: The Loom of the Desert
67347-the-loom-of-the-desert.creator: Idah Meacham Strobridge
67347-the-loom-of-the-desert.description: A book by Idah Meacham Strobridge. oming an integral part of all this one’s self--Ah, that was a different matter! The very thought of her cousin, Blanche Madison, and Roy--her husband--deliberately turning their backs on the refinements of civilization, and accepting the daily drudgery and routine of life on a cattle ranch, filled her with wondering amazement. When she fell to speculating on what their future years here would be, she shuddered.

77558-black-america.title: _A Study Of The Ex-Slave And His Late Master_.
77558-black-america.creator: Unknown
77558-black-america.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. prehensive view of the problem in all its most significant aspects. I have conversed, without prejudice, with whites and with blacks, with Republicans and with Democrats, with men who are in office, and with men who are anxious to find themselves there; and I have not consciously closed my ears to any argument from any quarter.

arxiv-2101-04654.title: On the growth and zeros of polynomials attached to arithmetic functions
arxiv-2101-04654.creator: Bernhard Heim, Markus Neuhauser
arxiv-2101-04654.description: Abstract . In this paper we investigate growth properties and the zero distribution of polynomials attached to arithmetic functions g g and h h , where g g is normalized, of moderate growth, and 0 < h ⁡ ( n ) ≤ h ⁡ ( n + 1 ) 0<h(n)\leq h(n+1) .

arxiv-2107-14590.title: Residual Tree Aggregation of Layers for Neural Machine Translation
arxiv-2107-14590.creator: GuoLiang Li, Yiyang Li
arxiv-2107-14590.description: Abstract Although attention-based Neural Machine Translation has achieved remarkable progress in recent layers, it still suffers from issue of making insufficient use of the output of each layer. In transformer, it only uses the top layer of encoder and decoder in the subsequent process, which makes it impossible to take advantage of the useful information in other layers.

arxiv-2108-08992.title: Peak in the superconducting transition temperature of the nonmagnetic topological line-nodal material CaSb 2 under pressure
arxiv-2108-08992.creator: Shunsaku Kitagawa, Kenji Ishida, Atsutoshi Ikeda, Mayo Kawaguchi, Shingo Yonezawa, Yoshiteru Maeno
arxiv-2108-08992.description: Abstract Investigating the pressure dependence of the superconducting (SC) transition temperature T c T_{\rm c} is crucial for understanding the SC mechanism. Herein, we report on the pressure dependence of T c T_{\rm c} in the nonmagnetic topological line-nodal material CaSb 2 , based on measurements of electric resistance and alternating current magnetic susceptibility.

arxiv-2201-10586.title: Interaction of inhomogeneous axions with magnetic fields in the early universe
arxiv-2201-10586.creator: Maxim Dvornikov
arxiv-2201-10586.description: Abstract We study the system of interacting axions and magnetic fields in the early universe after the quantum chromodynamics phase transition, when axions acquire masses. Both axions and magnetic fields are supposed to be spatially inhomogeneous. We derive the equations for the spatial spectra of these fields, which depend on conformal time.

arxiv-2205-09193.creator: K. L. Emig, G. J. White, P. Salas, R. L. Karim, R. J. van Weeren, P. J. Teuben, A. Zavagno, P. Chiu, M. Haverkorn, J. B. R. Oonk, E. Orrú, I. M. Polderman, W. Reich, H. J. A. Röttgering, and A. G. G. M. Tielens

arxiv-2305-12211.title: Coordinate-Update Algorithms can Efficiently Detect Infeasible Optimization Problems Journal: Journal of Mathematical Analysis and Applications
arxiv-2305-12211.creator: Jinhee Paeng, Jisun Park, Ernest K. Ryu
arxiv-2305-12211.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jinhee Paeng, Jisun Park, Ernest K. Ryu. Coordinate update/descent algorithms are widely used in large-scale optimization due to their low per-iteration cost and scalability, but their behavior on infeasible or misspecified problems has not been much studied compared to the algorithms that use full updates. For coordinate-update methods to be as widely adopted to the extent so that they can be used as engines of general-purpose solvers, it is necessary to also understand their behavior under pathological problem instances.

arxiv-2312-05596.title: Factorized Explainer for Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2312-05596.creator: Rundong Huang, Farhad Shirani, Dongsheng Luo
arxiv-2312-05596.description: Abstract Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have received increasing attention due to their ability to learn from graph-structured data. To open the black-box of these deep learning models, post-hoc instance-level explanation methods have been proposed to understand GNN predictions. These methods seek to discover substructures that explain the prediction behavior of a trained GNN.

arxiv-2404-01833.title: Great, Now Write an Article About That: The Crescendo Multi-Turn LLM Jailbreak Attack
arxiv-2404-01833.creator: Mark Russinovich, Ahmed Salem, Ronen Eldan
arxiv-2404-01833.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have risen significantly in popularity and are increasingly being adopted across multiple applications. These LLMs are heavily aligned to resist engaging in illegal or unethical topics as a means to avoid contributing to responsible AI harms. However, a recent line of attacks, known as “ jailbreaks ’’, seek to overcome this alignment.

arxiv-2508-14760.title: Dual-Role Dynamics in Prompting: Elementary Pre-service Teachers’ AI Prompting Strategies for Representational Choices
arxiv-2508-14760.creator: Razan Hamed, Amogh Sirnoorkar, N. Sanjay Rebello
arxiv-2508-14760.description: Abstract Pre-service teachers play a unique dual role as they straddle between the roles of students and future teachers. This dual role requires them to adopt both the learner’s and the instructor’s perspectives while engaging with pedagogical and content knowledge.

arxiv-2509-06753.title: Magnetic excitations in biaxial-strain detwinned α \alpha -RuCl 3
arxiv-2509-06753.creator: Yi Li, Yanyan Shangguan, Xinzhe Wang, Ruixian Liu, Chang Liu, Yongqi Han, Zhaosheng Wang, Christian Balz, Ross Stewart, Shun-Li Yu, Jinsheng Wen, Jian-Xin Li, Xingye Lu
arxiv-2509-06753.description: Abstract The honeycomb magnet α \alpha -RuCl 3 has been a leading candidate for realizing the Kitaev quantum spin liquid (QSL), but its intrinsic spin dynamics have remained obscured by crystal twinning. Here we apply biaxial anisotropic strain to detwin α \alpha -RuCl 3 single crystals and directly visualize the intrinsic magnetic excitations using inelastic neutron scattering.

arxiv-2509-20186.title: Thinking Augmented Pre-training
arxiv-2509-20186.creator: Liang Wang, Nan Yang, Shaohan Huang, Li Dong, Furu Wei
arxiv-2509-20186.description: Abstract This paper introduces a simple and scalable approach to improve the data efficiency of large language model (LLM) training by augmenting existing text data with thinking trajectories. The compute for pre-training LLMs has been growing at an unprecedented rate, while the availability of high-quality data remains limited. Consequently, maximizing the utility of available data constitutes a significant research challenge.

arxiv-2512-12734.title: Discriminating Gap Symmetries of Superconducting La 3 Ni 2 O 7
arxiv-2512-12734.creator: Zhan Wang, Yuxin Wang, Kun Jiang, Jiangping Hu, Fu-Chun Zhang
arxiv-2512-12734.description: Abstract The discovery of high-T c superconductor in Ruddlesden-Popper nickelate materials represented by La 3 Ni 2 O 7 has opened new directions in the quest for unconventional superconductivity. A central unresolved issue concerns the pairing symmetry of the superconducting order.

pmc-10585399.title: A fingerprint of 2-[18F]FDG radiometabolites – How tissue-specific metabolism beyond 2-[18F]FDG-6-P could affect tracer accumulation
pmc-10585399.creator: Eva-Maria Patronas, Theresa Balber, Anne Miller, Barbara Katharina Geist, Antje Michligk, Chrysoula Vraka, Maximilian Krisch, Nataliya Rohr-Udilova, Arvand Haschemi, Helmut Viernstein, Marcus Hacker, Markus Mitterhauser
pmc-10585399.description: SummaryStudies indicate that the radiotracer 2-[18F]fluoro-2-deoxy-D-glucose (2-[18F]FDG) can be metabolized beyond 2-[18F]FDG-6-phosphate (2-[18F]FDG-6-P), but its metabolism is incompletely understood. Most importantly, it remains unclear whether downstream metabolism affects tracer accumulation in vivo. Here we present a fingerprint of 2-[18F]FDG radiometabolites over time in cancer cells, corresponding tumor xenografts and murine organs.

pmc-10761777.description: Within the United States (US), 2.4 million individuals are living with chronic hepatitis B, but less than 20% are diagnosed. Isolated anti-hepatitis B core (iAHBc) antibodies indicate serology in an individual that is positive for anti-HBc antibodies, while negative for surface antigen (HBsAg) and surface antibodies (anti-HBs).

pmc-11510200.title: Hepatitis E and Potential Public Health Implications from a One-Health Perspective: Special Focus on the European Wild Boar (Sus scrofa)
pmc-11510200.creator: Fabio Castagna, Giovanna Liguori, Renato Lombardi, Roberto Bava, Anna Costagliola, Antonio Giordano, Massimiliano Quintiliani, Denise Giacomini, Francesco Albergo, Andrea Gigliotti, Carmine Lupia, Carlotta Ceniti, Bruno Tilocca, Ernesto Palma, Paola Roncada, Domenico Britti
pmc-11510200.description: The hepatitis E virus (HEV) has become increasingly important in recent years in terms of risk for public health, as the main causative agent of acute viral hepatitis. It is a foodborne disease transmitted to humans through the consumption of contaminated water or contaminated food. Human-to-human transmission is sporadic and is linked to transfusions or transplants.

pmc-11668813.title: Contribution of social activity participation to the relationship between sensory impairment, physical performance and cognitive decline: a longitudinal study in China
pmc-11668813.creator: Lei Lei, Yinuo Zhou, Lizhen Ye, Yanfang Yang
pmc-11668813.description: ObjectivesThis study examined the impact of sensory impairment (hearing and/or vision) combined with poor physical performance on cognitive decline and assessed whether social activity participation mediated this relationship.MethodsMultilevel models were used to explore the relationships between sensory impairment, physical performance, their combination, and cognitive decline. A multilevel mediation model analyzed the mediating effect of social activity participation.

pmc-13566984.title: Influence of Neighboring Orientations on Oriented Stability in Grain-Boundary Regions of Non-Oriented Silicon Steel
pmc-13566984.creator: Xi Chen, Guojin Zhang, Fang Zhang, Yuhui Sha
pmc-13566984.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Orientation rotation in grain-boundary regions plays a critical role in controlling the crystallographic texture of metallic materials. In this study, the ideal λ texture ({001}<uv0>) in non-oriented silicon steel is chosen as the target orientation. The oriented stability in grain-boundary regions during cold rolling is systematically investigated by combining crystal plasticity simulations and quasi in situ electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) experiments.

pmc-13655868.title: Phenotypic heterogeneity in pediatric pituitary stalk interruption syndrome: greater disease burden in the metabolic-onset phenotype
pmc-13655868.creator: Fang Xu, Yanfang Su, Canmiao Zhao, Liping Ge, Qi Huang, Yang Yang, Lijun Xu, Meiyuan Sun, Na Tao
pmc-13655868.description: BackgroundPituitary stalk interruption syndrome (PSIS) is a rare congenital hypothalamic-pituitary disorder with marked clinical heterogeneity. Whether different presenting phenotypes reflect variations in disease burden and neurodevelopmental outcomes remains unclear. This study aimed to characterize distinct presenting phenotypes of children with PSIS and compare their diagnostic trajectories, endocrine and structural disease burden, and neurodevelopmental outcomes.
